name: Tenryū (Japan)
description: A orange field charged at the centre with the Tenryū village emblem in green: a stylised bird-like swirl with a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Tenryū, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Tenryū village emblem — a stylised bird-like swirl with a ring
